description: LSC Pro Bono Innovation Fund 2026 round as LSC's two 14 October 2026 press releases print it, before the PBIF Awards page lists the round (checked 18 October 2026: the page still ends at 2025). Grantee names and amounts are copied as printed (whole dollars). `kind` is `grant` or `scholarship` (the new Grantee Engagement Scholarships). `printed_by` is LSC, or the member of Congress whose quote in the release gives the amount. Each award's state is the place its release names. Read by hand twice from the saved pages, 18 October 2026. CC BY 4.0.
